transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the merchandise settlement plan for the closing artist's one-night performance. As you all know, we've agreed to use the festival's point-of-sale system and settle the artist's share after the event, and I'll be the one approving the final plan. Before I can sign off on the event paperwork, festival policy requires that the artist liaison, merchandise manager, and finance manager each make a recorded disclosure of their relevant findings at our daily production closeout. So let's start hearing from each of you — what do we need to address?
